name: YDLIDAR X4 Pro
description: Low-cost 360° 2D triangulation lidar with 10 m range and 5 kHz ranging on an open belt-driven chassis.

specs.label: Laser
specs.value: 793 nm (775–800), 3 mW avg (5 max), FDA Class I / IEC 60825-1

specs.label: Interface / power
specs.value: UART 128000 8N1, 3.3 V, Tx only (PH2.0-8P); 5 V (4.8–5.2 V), 330 mA working, 800–1000 mA start

envelope.axes: x = length (lidar head to motor end), y = width, z = 41.4 from datum A (underside of the base plate) to top + 18.0 standoffs below it

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: 3× M3 (threaded, in the standoff ends, View G). Top view: left hole 39.9 left of the rotation centre and 5.4 below the centre line; upper-right hole 76.5 right of the left hole and 28.1 above the centre line; lower-right hole 79.6 right of the left hole and 27.7 below the centre line.

features.label: Optical centre height
features.value: 31.7 ±0.6 above datum A (underside of the base plate) = 49.7 above the standoff ends; optical window 10.5 tall.

features.label: Heights
features.value: Top 41.4 ±0.6 above datum A; standoffs 18.0 ±0.6 below datum A; head/motor section above the PCB 22.7 ±0.6. Head Ø68.7 ±0.3. Runout 0.8 (head) and 0.5 (top) to A.

features.label: Connector
features.value: PH2.0-8P receptacle (VCC, Tx, NC, GND, M_CTR, NC, NC, NC).

amazon.title: youyeetoo YDLIDAR X4 Pro 360 Degree, 2D Laser Range Lidar Scanner, Triangular Ranging 10 Meters Scanning Radius, for Arduino Raspberry pi Obstacle Avoidance and Navigation of Robots

notes: No official 3D CAD found: the current ydlidar.com product page and Doc&Tool download center list only datasheets/manuals/SDKs, and YDLIDAR's GitHub repos contain no meshes. No community model was verified either. Height conflict: ydlidar.com product page says 110.6 × 71.1 × 52.3 mm, while the datasheet drawing (V1.1, 2024-01-24) gives 71.5 width and 41.4 + 18.0 = 59.4 total height including standoffs; the drawing is used here. Datasheet title is 'X4PRO' (doc# 01.13.001700). Development manual also downloaded. Amazon seller youyeetoo is a reseller, not a YDLIDAR-owned store.
